lead.body: The IRGC says two tankers and an LNG carrier hit mines in Hormuz. One supertanker carried over two million barrels. CENTCOM says the main lanes are mine-free.
lead.headline: THREE TANKERS HIT MINES IN HORMUZ

lead.body: The Houthis say they struck Ras Tanura, Saudi Arabia's largest refinery at 550,000 barrels a day. Satellite images show thick black smoke. Oil loadings were suspended.
lead.headline: HOUTHIS HIT RAS TANURA REFINERY

lead.body: Washington proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners to counter excess factory capacity. China faces the highest, an extra 20%. A hearing is set for 25 January.
lead.headline: US TARIFFS HIT 14 PARTNERS

small.body: Brent settled at $96.57, up 2.1% on Thursday after fresh mine claims in the Gulf.
small.headline: BRENT $96.57 AS GULF ATTACKS LIFT OIL

small.body: Strikes and gunfire killed 10 across Gaza, including a Hamas deputy minister.
small.headline: ISRAEL KILLS TEN IN GAZA ON THURSDAY

small.body: A tanker master reported an explosion 50 nautical miles west of Dubai. Crew safe.
small.headline: BLAST NEAR TANKER WEST OF DUBAI

small.body: Two Italian technicians died in a drone strike in Kuwait. Tehran denies blame.
small.headline: IRAN DRONES KILL TWO ITALIANS IN KUWAIT

small.body: A projectile hit Jazan refinery, killing one worker and halting some operations.
small.headline: HOUTHI STRIKE KILLS ONE AT JAZAN REFINERY

small.body: The Bank of Korea raised its base rate 25 bps to 3.25% in a 5-2 vote.

small.body: Taiex +2.50%, Nikkei +0.86%, Kospi +0.29%, shrugging off new US tariffs.

small.body: Leaders ended 12 hours of talks with no deal on a €45bn Ukraine loan or the €1.58tn budget.

small.body: A fuel tanker overturned on Cairo's Ring Road and ignited, killing at least 31.

small.body: The 100th Macy's parade was postponed to Saturday, a first for weather.
